files.insight: Function-level noduplicate is a legality restriction distinct from profitability and remains effective under forced specialization.
A noduplicate operation inside a body prevents cloning even without a matching function annotation. Legality requires checking transitive operation constraints, not only outer flags.
A volatile store prevents recursive constant-stack promotion; equal values alone do not erase observable memory effects.
Multiple stores prevent the simple unique-store promotion rule even if stored expressions match; supporting more cases needs a stronger alias/effect analysis.
Unsupported allocation types do not gain integer promotion merely because a downstream consumer reads integers. Typed storage and initialization remain required.
Specialization-created counters track actual clones, separately from discovered or ranked candidates; test requires assertions-enabled statistics support.

Enabling/disabling cloning is independently tested; known function arguments become direct calls and the fully specialized internal original disappears. This differs from merely unfolding at each call.

Recursive function-valued arguments can redirect recursive calls within each clone, then dead-argument elimination removes bound callback parameters and unused returns. Iteration zero disables clones but ordinary solver simplification continues.
Forcing specialization bypasses profitability for tiny constant-global cases; successful clone generation is not evidence that default ranking should choose it.
Whole multi-argument signatures specialize together under a clone-count budget; max-clones1 versus2 changes the available family while preserving remaining original users.
If every known call passes the same constant signature, ordinary interprocedural propagation suffices; avoid redundant cloning even under force.

Distribute observed entry counts among clones according to redirected callsite weights, subtract from the original and preserve zero-count caller behavior. Do not duplicate whole profile counts into each clone; observations remain non-authoritative.

Readonly, nonescaping single-store stack values can expose successive recursive specialization, with each bounded iteration enabling more downstream folding/inlining. Preserve print order and termination; no unlimited unrolling.

Recursive specialization profitability must penalize cumulative family growth so clone count does not scale mechanically with maximum iterations. Assertions-enabled fixture checks four clones under100 iterations.

Strict floating comparisons carry metadata operands that are not scalar lattice values. Preserve floating exception effects while specializing unrelated constant arguments; cannot treat all call operands uniformly.
Profitability combines pre-existing solver constants with proposed argument constants to expose branch savings. Avoid forgetting upstream facts or double-counting already removed work.
Dead-block savings depend on all surviving predecessors, combining existing solver-dead paths with newly specialized paths; checking only a local branch misses transitive savings.

Cost analysis must look through PredicateInfo copy wrappers while respecting their scoped facts, and temporary analysis forms must be removed afterward. Representation changes between passes affect discoverable opportunities.

validation: Full source review only; opt/FileCheck not executed. Expected outputs and statistics are test specifications, not results of a local LLVM run.
